extracted.intended_audience: UCI researchers, laboratory personnel, and visitors who will work with live animals
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional requirements and steps UCI personnel (and visiting/sponsored users) must complete to be authorized to work with live animals, including required courses, health screening, facility access training, documentation, and refresher frequencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorization prerequisite: complete training and safety assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Education, training, and safety assessments must be completed before being authorized to work with live animals at UCI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an overarching requirement: no authorization to work with live animals until required trainings and safety assessments are complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: CITI Training (required prior to protocol submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic training in the ethical and humane use of live animals in research is provided via the Collaborative Institutional Training Initiative (CITI) and is required prior to protocol submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refresher training is required every 3 years. Ensure the correct CITI modules for animal research are completed and linked to UCI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tutorial Verification Search (CITI linkage verification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get verification that your CITI training is complete and linked properly to UCI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided tool to confirm CITI completion and institutional linkage before relying on that training for authorization or protocol submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: LAOHP questionnaire (annual requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Laboratory Animal Occupational Health Program (LAOHP) identifies, evaluates, manages and reduces potential health risks associated with the care and use of animals. Completion of the LAOHP questionnaire is required annually for everyone with live animal contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All personnel who will have live animal contact must complete this annual health/screening questionnaire to remain in compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: ULAR Researcher Training Class (required)
rubrics_metrics.description: This required class covers ULAR policies and procedures, and some IACUC policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendance/completion of the ULAR Researcher Training Class is mandatory for researchers interacting with animals; it complements CITI training by covering local facility and policy topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training for ULAR Animal Facility Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Training for ULAR Animal Facility Access includes ULAR classroom training, animal facility orientation tour, and other applicable CITI training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Completion of the classroom training and orientation (and any additional specified CITI modules) is required to gain physical access to ULAR animal facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Procedures Training (hands-on by ULAR Veterinary Services)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural instructions and hands-on training by ULAR Veterinary Services for animal handling, basic biomethodology, surgical techniques, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel must receive hands-on, procedure-specific training appropriate to the tasks they will perform; training is provided by ULAR Veterinary Services and tailored to techniques (handling, surgery, methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: EH&S Personnel Safety Training (assess and complete needed modules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine your personal safety-training needs by completing the Safety Training Self Assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the self-assessment to identify required Environmental Health & Safety training modules and then complete those modules to meet safety requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active UCINetID for sponsored/guest users
rubrics_metrics.description: An active UCINetID is required for everyone working with live animals in research or teaching activities at UCI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visitors or sponsored users must obtain a UCINetID to participate; see provided information on obtaining a UCINetID for visitors before accessing animals or facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Training Record (one per team member; maintain in lab)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research personnel participating in activities with live animals require hands-on training of the procedures they will be performing. One personnel training record must be maintained for EACH member of the laboratory study team to document the training they received related to their assigned activities with live animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission of this form to the IACUC is NOT required, but records must be maintained within the lab and may be requested during facility inspections. A Personnel Training Record template is provided.
